newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian rubber softens in noon trading.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian rubber softens in noon trading.

text.p: Indonesian tyre-grade SIR20 rubber prices softened in noon trading on Wednesday after a fall in prices in Japan, traders said.
They said U.S. buyers bought rubber at 46.75 U.S. cents/lb fob Padang for July shipment and offer prices in other centres fell because of that.
"Prices are falling today and this is really surprising, given the bullish trend in the past few days. Some traders attribute the decline to the fall in prices in Japan," one trader said.
Traders said offer prices were heard at 47.00 fob Medan and Surabaya, 46.50 fob Palembang and 46.00 fob Pontianak and Jambi.
